newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Demand keeps Colombo rubber prices buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Demand keeps Colombo rubber prices buoyant.

text.p: Crepe prices were firm at the Colombo auction on Thursday where good demand for the 193 tonnes of latex and 52 tonnes of scrap kept prices buoyant, brokers and buyers said.
"The market did not see much activity today, but those who were there needed the rubber," said a trader at brokerage John Keells. "There was good demand for the quantities that were available."
Best latex one-x, the purest grade, fetched 72.50 ($1.28) per kg, which was unchanged from Tuesday when the auction was last held.
RSS 1 dropped to 63.90 per kg from 64.15, but number one firmed by 25 cents to 71.25 from last Tuesday, brokers said.
"We expected prices to come down further, but it did not happen," a leading buyer said. "People were buying in the market today to cover their production needs."
The next rubber auction will be on December 31 due to next week's Christmas holidays, brokers said.
